scientific_integrity: Analytic result with exact rational and polynomial checks. Historical novelty is provisional; no independent external validation.
scientific_limitations: Two taxa with identical known Poisson intensities, a single shared Bernoulli viability indicator per independent bottle, fixed total effort, no per-bottle fixed costs; records from separately assayed samples are unioned, not physically pooled; no field validation.
title: Equal-active sampling with an abrupt one-to-three replication jump for two-target detection
